title: 第808章 只要认识的够久那就是老熟人，见过一面的也算！
slug: 宗门收徒我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

南瞻部洲，渝州城。

缘空站在安放缘静舍利的宝塔前静静站着。

万般念头，唯有不舍最磨人。

或许只是因为曾经拥有过，所以才习惯不了没有。

“老和尚，当年你也藏私了，没教我怎么放下。”缘空伸手轻摸向宝塔，感受着指尖粗糙的磨砂感，语气有几分无奈道，“这年头当个真和尚是最苦的。”

“想自私却也自私不得，当年你就不能教点假和尚路子。”

缘空叹完气，挥了挥土黄色的僧袍：

“不过罢了，也不能都怪你，毕竟你死的早，那时我也还没长大，自然不能什么道理都来得及教我。”

“我这一路从东胜神洲跑来，可也算浪费了我不少时间。”

“特意跑这一趟主要是想和你说一声，将来八成有好长一段时间不会来了。”

“自然，找你聊聊天，消遣一下心中感情的事也有。”

“另外禅林寺发展的也挺好，人家现在管理的比当年你管的强多了。”

“所以如果后面我再来了，希望你还在这里待着。”

缘空站在塔前把话讲完，接着就搂起袖口，留下一身土黄色的背影开始往阶梯下走去。

修为到位之后，昔日的黑皮和尚也恢复了白皙的面容。

当年模样还算标致的小和尚长相也还算有些俊美。

缘空一路平静的走出了禅林寺，接着他屏蔽了自身气息，开始由禅林寺外漫步往外走去。

渝州城变化也有，只是没有那么大。

偶尔看见巡逻走过的镇妖司成员也都换了面孔，不知道昔日认识的旧人是否还在。

昔日回忆之中的街道再重新踏上的时候，总会让人有种重回旧日记忆时的感觉。

缘空慢步走出渝州城的大城门，接着他回头转身，心中正感慨万千。

“好看吗？”

“故乡自然好看。”

缘空听见熟悉的声音自然而然的开口回答，接着才缓过神来，目光惊恐的望向了声音传来的方向。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Looking south to Buzhou, Yuzhou City.

Yuankong stood quietly in front of the pagoda where Yuanjing's relics were placed.

Of all the thoughts, reluctance is the most irritating.

Maybe it’s just because I’ve had it before that I can’t get used to not having it.

"Old monk, you were hiding something secret back then, and you didn't teach me how to let it go." Yuankong stretched out his hand to touch the pagoda, feeling the rough abrasive feeling on his fingertips, and said in a helpless tone, "Being a true monk these days is the hardest."

"You want to be selfish but you can't be selfish. You couldn't teach fake monks back then."

Yuan Kong sighed and waved his khaki monk's robe:

"But that's all. I can't blame you entirely. After all, you died young and I wasn't grown up at that time. Naturally, you couldn't teach me everything."

"I ran all the way from Dongsheng Shenzhou, but it was a waste of my time."

"The main reason I made this trip is to tell you that I probably won't be here for a long time in the future."

"Of course, I would like to chat with you and relieve my feelings."

"In addition, Zenlin Temple is developing very well. Their management now is much better than what you managed back then."

"So if I come again later, I hope you will still stay here."

Yuankong stood in front of the tower and finished speaking. Then he rolled up his sleeves, leaving his khaki-colored back behind and started walking down the stairs.

After the cultivation was in place, the dark-skinned monk in the past also regained his fair complexion.

The little monk who looked pretty back then was also somewhat handsome.

Yuankong walked out of Zenlin Temple calmly, then he blocked his own aura and began to walk out of Zenlin Temple.

There have been changes in Yuzhou City, but not that big.

Occasionally, the members of the Demon Suppression Department who were seen patrolling by also changed their faces. I wonder if the old people I knew in the past are still there.

When you step back on the streets that you remember in the past, you will always feel like you are back in those old memories.

Yuankong slowly walked out of the main gate of Yuzhou City, and then he turned around, feeling filled with emotion in his heart.

"Does it look good?"

"My hometown is naturally beautiful."

Yuan Kong heard the familiar voice and answered naturally. Then he recovered and looked towards the direction of the voice in horror.
